lead.title: Pakistan squad announced for England Test series
lead.summary: Pakistan have picked a 15-man group for the home Test series. Two newcomers are in the squad while a senior bowler misses out.
lead.why: You follow Pakistan Politics (interest 50%). Also covered by several outlets today.

secondary.title: Anthropic proposes law regulating AI to US lawmakers
secondary.summary: Anthropic, the creator of the AI assistant Claude, confirmed on Friday it is circulating a draft bill among US lawmakers aimed at regulating artificial intelligence to address the lack of federal legislation on the risks posed by the new technology.

secondary.title: Pakistan showcases 20 tech firms at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
Pakistani startup raises seed funding for farm logistics
secondary.summary: A young company building cold-chain logistics for farmers has closed a seed funding round. It plans to expand to three new regions.

stories.title: Chip maker Nvidia shares climb as AI demand stays strong
stories.summary: Shares rose after the company said demand for AI chips remains high. Investors are watching supply limits closely.

stories.title: Roadmap set to boost trade with Malaysia
stories.summary: ISLAMABAD: Pakistan and Malaysia on Friday agreed on a roadmap to deepen trade and investment relations, identifying key areas of cooperation at a business conference.

stories.title: State Bank holds interest rate steady as inflation eases
stories.summary: The central bank kept its policy interest rate unchanged. Officials said inflation is cooling but risks remain.

stories.title: Leaders gather for summit on sanctions and trade
stories.summary: Heads of government met to discuss sanctions policy and trade rules. A joint statement is expected on the final day.

stories.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
stories.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

stories.title: Ceasefire talks resume as United Nations urges aid access
stories.summary: Negotiators returned to the table as the United Nations pressed for safe aid routes. Officials described the talks as difficult.
